title: India Gate Ke Top 5 Food Outlets | Food Court in India Gate, New Delhi
description:
India Gate Food Court Google Map Location: https://share.google/38aGhty2pjPeTZQ24

Welcome to another exciting episode of Bhooka Saand Food Tour! In this vlog, we explore the India Gate Food Court in New Delhi, a hidden gem for street food lovers looking to try diverse Indian regional cuisines in one place.

From Assam to Tamil Nadu, Rajasthan to Bihar, and even Sikkim, this food court near India Gate offers a mini tour of India on your plate! In this Delhi Food Vlog, we tried:
🍜 Veg Momos
🍗 Chicken Momos
🔥 Litti Chokha
🌯 Masala Dosa
🍝 Veg Noodles
🥟 Pyaj Kachori
🥤 Refreshing Lassi

The food here is affordable, authentic, and absolutely delicious. Whether you're a local or a tourist, this place is a must-visit for food in India Gate.
📍 Perfect spot for your next Delhi Food Tour
🍽️ Highly recommended for fans of Delhi Street Food
🎥 Don’t miss this flavorful journey at the India Gate Food Court

If you enjoyed this vlog, don’t forget to like, share, and subscribe for more food explorations across Delhi!
